intro: St. Clair County sits between Birmingham and Gadsden, with towns along I-20, I-59, US-11, and US-411, plus communities around Logan Martin Lake. We are based in Springville and buy houses across the county as a cash buyer, not as a listing agent.

Whether the house is in a lakefront neighborhood, an older downtown street, or a quieter road outside town, you can sell it as-is. No clean-out, no showings, and no repair list. Closings usually take as little as 7-14 days, depending on title work, and you pick the move-out date.

Moving toward Birmingham, out of the county, or out of state, you can time the closing to your move.

Usually in as little as 7-14 days, depending on title work. If you need more time, you pick the date that works for you.
Which St. Clair County towns do you buy in?
We buy in Springville, Pell City, Odenville, Moody, and other communities in St. Clair County. If your town is not listed, call 205-914-4215 and ask.
Do I have to make repairs or clean out the house?
No. We buy as-is. Take what you want and leave the rest. We'll handle it.
Are there any fees or commissions?
No. There are no agent commissions and no hidden fees, and in most cases we cover the normal closing costs.
Will you buy a house near Logan Martin Lake or outside city limits?
Yes. We buy houses as-is in towns and in unincorporated parts of the county. Call if you want to confirm your address.
How do you decide on my offer?
We look at your home's location, condition, needed repairs, and recent nearby sales. Then we give you a fair, no-obligation cash offer, often the same day.
